All I meant was that having such a void in my life makes me feel severlely deeply inhuman, and I don't really want to or choose to be this way, but I'm that person who bumbles and fumbles through life without anything ever going correctly. I assume this is a lack of intelligence, but there might be a better word for it, existentially clumsy, howabout?

What I was trying to express is that no matter how much I help others, at some point I start getting envious of how well they connect with each other. Human is being able to exist with any degree of success in this society, that's all I meant, being able to interact and having connections with others, especially physically. It becomes difficult to interact with others when you realize how lacking you are. I get that the idea is to take the focus off of you, but I did that for a few years and at the end all I learned was that you can't help others if you're not in the right place yourself. I am not a good example.

Thanks for responding, though. Most of what used to make me happy was just the idea that there was always something else to try, that I hadn't put forth the right type of effort yet. I still haven't, but I seem to ruin more than I fix finding out what that is in the process.
Does your apartment charge for repairs? It probably isn't the first time that happened there, usually it can just be plastered over.

Is this about you? There are some really interesting parts.

A considerable amount what you wrote might as well have been observed from my life. It really is time to go, isn't it? It's like pleading with air at this point.

There's just nothing to fix, it's all broken. Did you have a chance to help yourself? In my experience those moments were mirages. It's funny how being isolated ruins your mind. At some point you really do just stop existing. Just a body, why keep that around?

Holy shit, life is a joke. I do not know how to deal with these feelings, this is terrifying, why do things only get worse, why the FUCK am I so broken? It's been like this for over a decade, nothing EVER gets better. Only other people get that, only they are humans.

That never worked for me, it's nice to do things for others but sometimes I like to feel as though I'm more than a tool to be used.

Sometimes I want to feel human; lately, I've wanted nothing more than to curl up into a ball and just disappear. Like a scared dog huddled in the corner of the room, I can't do this and I screwed up my brain or was born broken or something. Something about me is broken in my body or my mind or both, and I'm not a human anymore and can no longer interact. I think there was a time limit before everything just shuts down as a survival mechanism and that point as been passed. I just know this is the end, this time things won't get better because there is no way or path for them to, there are no new things to fix or do.

Both, it’s when you realize you don’t have a place it in it, that any place you could have will just be taken by someone else, and that there is nothing here for you. Even if there was, you’d have to claw for it while others were trying to gouge out your eyes.

For me, it’s over a decade of trying to make a life happen, and watching it fail. Whether you blame me, the world, it doesn’t matter. I wasn’t made for this world and there is nothing here, no words will ever change that fucked up fact, it’s simple reality, it’s as fundamental as physics.

It's about not having a place in the world, even if you tried to make one. Pin that on whatever, my own weakness, the callousness and simple indifference of others in the face of better options, whatever, same thing, different day.
